dedupe_keys.name: jba risk management global flood maps flood data and catastrophe models

description: JBA Risk Management sells flood hazard maps, location-level flood data, probabilistic catastrophe models and event sets for every country, aimed at insurers and at organisations with regulatory reporting needs. Coverage: global flood maps with extents and depths for multiple return periods for river (fluvial), surface water (pluvial) and coastal flooding, at 30 m resolution for every country and 5 m for the UK, Ireland, the USA, continental Europe and major populated regions of Australia; they are built with JBA's proprietary 2D hydraulic model JFlow and updated in a regular programme; the Flood Data suite gives location-level flood depths, climate change flood depths under several future scenarios and time horizons, and flood scores, covering river and surface water worldwide and coastal flooding in specific regions; catastrophe models cover present-day and climate change scenarios, with crop and combined wind and flood models, and the global event sets hold over 15 million simulated flood events. Format and access: platform-agnostic delivery, including integration into client systems and JBA online services; commercial. Licence: commercial terms, not read. Caveats: prices, file formats and the exact return periods were not given on the pages read. Simulation uses: flood depths and event sets for hazard exposure, probabilistic loss and resilience analysis of infrastructure portfolios, and climate adaptation scenarios. Related records: Fathom's global flood map (data-fathom-global-flood-map-and-terrain), a competing product, and the open EFAS and GloFAS forecasts (data-efas-european-flood-awareness-system, data-glofas).
